data.Name: Aggressive Squirrel
data.Description: A squirrel the size of a small dog sits atop an absurdly large pile of nuts, acorns, berries, coins, keys, someone's left shoe, and what appears to be a crown. It chitters aggressively and flexes tiny muscles at you. This squirrel has clearly been hitting the gym.
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.35, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The squirrel cracks its knuckles. You didn't know squirrels had knuckles. It gestures at its hoard and then draws a tiny line in the dirt with its tail.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Negotiate for Nuts", "risk": 0.4, "success": {"type": "draw_card", "text": "After an intense negotiation conducted entirely in squeaks and hand gestures, the squirrel agrees to share some nuts. It throws something useful at your head as a sign of respect.", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}, "failure": {"type": "spawn_enemy", "text": "The squirrel lets out a war cry! From every tree, dozens of squirrels appear! The squirrel army attacks! You have made a terrible miscalculation!", "params": {"deck": "beta_enemy_deck.json", "count": 1}}}, {"name": "Walk Away Slowly", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "none", "text": "You choose peace today. The squirrel nods approvingly. It respects those who know when they're outmatched. You hear it resume counting its hoard as you leave."}}]}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "none", "text": "On closer inspection, the 'squirrel' is actually a very convincing hat someone left behind on top of a pile of nuts. You feel silly for being intimidated by headwear.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "none", "text": "A hawk swoops down and carries the squirrel away. The squirrel shakes its fist at you from the sky as if this is somehow your fault.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "draw_card", "text": "The squirrel sneezes and accidentally launches a nut directly into your bag. Possession is nine-tenths of the law. The squirrel is too proud to ask for it back.", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}]
